prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, but underestimated gains for winning tests in home notifications, adoption new flows, sign-in reorders, and choose path layouts.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), home notifications (home, notification), adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow), and choose path layouts (choose_path, layout) were helpful across multiple winning tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) either caused rollbacks due to negative impacts or showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once (including adoption incentive, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint/incentive/new_flow, home new_flow, and sign_in new_flow), requiring at least 2 tests to state a pattern.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Waiting Screen Step: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after the waiting screen, after pet assets have finished generating. (why: Reordering sign-in has previously delivered significant conversion gains. Prompting sign-in after pet generation completes ties account creation directly to the newly created pet.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Voice Preview Companion Flow: Adds an interactive audio voice sample component to companion choices on the pick friend screen. (why: Adoption new flows have strong evidence of success. Allowing users to hear pet audio samples increases emotional connection during adoption selection.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Two Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose path screen into a clean two-column layout contrasting preset companion adoption against custom photo upload. (why: Choose path layout changes consistently yielded conversion improvements in previous winning tests, helping users decide faster (currently 514s mean time).)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Photo Upload Pre-flight Verification Screen: Inserts a dedicated image quality verification screen right after photo upload before sending photos to render. (why: Support emails show user frustration with failed or malformed custom pet generation. Verifying uploads prevents generation errors before entering the waiting phase.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Grid Display Redesign: Rebuild the pet selection interface using a grid layout that displays all available companions simultaneously. (why: Redesigning the pet selection view helps streamline decision-making on adoption (currently 75.7% conversion).)
5: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Completion Audio Chime Notification: Triggers a audio completion chime when pet asset creation finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Home notifications are proven winners across multiple tests. Audio cues effectively alert users who stepped away during long render wait times.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Render Estimate Progress Display: Displays an estimated time countdown timer component on the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: The waiting step has high mean latency (2336s). Clear wait duration expectations reduce drop-off caused by perceived hanging.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Compact View Layout: Update the story screen to use a compact layout for faster initial browsing. (why: The first step conversion is 78.5%. Streamlining the initial story presentation reduces initial drop-off.)
8: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Full Bleed Experience Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a full-bleed visual showcase introducing the pet on the desktop. (why: The finish step takes a median of 395s. A visually immersive full-bleed layout creates an exciting conclusion to onboarding.)
